description:
FILED s531c (Opus agent, 2026-11-01), the PPI half of #4083 (s531c fixed the PCL half: the statement-modifier SPLIT).  PRE-EXISTING.  LOUD (a drop; a run-time die when reached).  FOR THE NEXT PPI BATCH (s531c touches no PPI file, by its brief).

    package F; sub AUTOLOAD { our $AUTOLOAD; my $n = $AUTOLOAD; $n =~ s/.*:://; return if $n eq 'DESTROY'; "$n(@_[1..$#_])" }
    package main; my $f = bless {}, 'F';
    print $f->if(1), " ", $f->elsif(2), " ", $f->unless(3), " ", $f->while(4), " ", $f->until(5), "\n";
  perl 5.40.3: if(1) elsif(2) unless(3) while(4) until(5)
  PCL (s531c tree): PCL: statement dropped ... Bug. Fell through. Missing case: [methodcall, 'Structure::Condition<(1)>']
Probe: scratch/s531c/p/kw3.pl in the s531c worktree.

PPI dump (vendored PPI pcl 9286f7c0) of `$f->if(1);`:
    PPI::Statement / Symbol '$f' / Operator '->' / Word 'if' / PPI::Structure::Condition ( PPI::Statement::Expression ( Number '1' ) )
  expected: PPI::Structure::List ( PPI::Statement::Expression ... ) -- what `$f->for(1)` / `->foreach(` / `->given(` / `->when(` already get (those four words are not in the table).

CAUSE (vendor/PPI/lib/PPI/Lexer.pm, `_round`, line ~1170): `my $Element = $Parent->schild(-1); if (_INSTANCE($Element, 'PPI::Token::Word')) { my $rclass = $ROUND{$Element->content}; return $rclass if $rclass; }` -- %ROUND maps if / elsif / unless / while / until to PPI::Structure::Condition with no test that the Word is a method name.  toke.c: a word after `->` is read in XOPERATOR state as a METHOD name, never a keyword.  Fix shape: skip the table when the Word's previous significant sibling is the `->` Operator (the same test `_round`'s own List branch makes below it for `->(`).  PCL needs NO change after it: the s531c split predicate (`Pl::PExpr::Config::is_statement_modifier_word`) already answers NO after `->`, and `$f->foreach(@x)` (a List to PPI) lowers and runs = perl.

ROWS: the Template-Toolkit rows still blessed to #4083 after s531c (re-caused to this task by edit) -- every template with [% IF %] / [% UNLESS %] / [% WHILE %]; Template::Grammar.pm lines 5487 5493 5499 5505 (->if) 5585 5591 (->while) are the 6 drops left of 8 (`./pl2cl --module < Grammar.pm`, base ade297e7: 8, s531c: 6 -- the two ->foreach drops fixed).
GUARD for the fix: add the paren rows (`$f->if(@a[2,4,5])`, `->while(1)`, `->unless(`, `->until(`, `->elsif(`) to Pl/t/method-modifier-name-01.t; the PPI twin row to docs/ppi-bug-report.t / t/ppi_bugs_pcl.t.

=== MEASURED (s531c): the fix shape is enough; PCL needs nothing more ===
A scratch copy of the s531c tree (scratch/s531c/exp/, NOT the branch) with `_round`'s keyword lookup skipped when the Word's sprevious_sibling is the `->` Operator: scratch/s531c/p/kw.pl and kw3.pl (all five keyword methods with parens, inside an anon sub, followed by a real modifier, as a class method) print exactly perl's output.  So #4201 = one PPI condition + the paren rows in Pl/t/method-modifier-name-01.t.


=== DONE (s531e) ===
Fixed on PCL's PPI branch: group AO (TODO tests 7bd8dfcd, fix db20f1eb on pcl-s531e): PPI::Lexer::_round skips its keyword table when the word follows ->, so ->if( / ->elsif( / ->unless( / ->while( / ->until( (and ->for( / ->foreach( directly) build a Structure::List holding a Statement::Expression.  Catalogue §58, report rows (plan 304 -> 310), registry row 58 fixed_in pcl.  PCL needed no change.  Template/Grammar.pm (--module) drops 6 -> 0.  Guard rows 10-11 of Pl/t/method-modifier-name-01.t (inverse-verified: both fail on a 436d82e4 extraction).  corpus-diff vs 436d82e4 IDENTICAL; wide emission-ab 1360 SAME / 0 DIFF / RCDIFF 0; lib 57 SAME; gate 348 / 11,695 PASS.  Board: the 153 rows keyed on #4201 left baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv BY EDIT (one-file runs: 16 of the 17 TT files 0 fail; include.t 45/2 = #4086 rows 31 33, unchanged).

=== STATUS HELD in_progress (s531 end, the reviewing session): the batch that fixed this has NOT merged; CLOSE-WITH-ROWS -- the reviewing session sets completed in the merge commit, when the rows keyed on it leave main ===
subject: PPI builds the parenthesis after a METHOD named `if` / `elsif` / `unless` / `while` / `until` as a Structure::Condition (`$f->if(1)`): PPI::Lexer::_round reads its keyword table without asking whether the Word follows `->` -- PCL's method-call lowering then drops the statement (Template::Grammar's IF / WHILE rules, the PPI half of #4083)
